adventures.title: The Missing Baker
adventures.hook: In the village of Honeyfield, the baker Old Tom has gone missing. His shop is locked from the outside, but smoke is rising from the chimney — and the bread smells like it's burning. The mayor asks you to find Tom and get the bread out before the whole shop catches fire!
adventures.secret: A clever Mischief Sprite snuck in last night looking for sweets and accidentally locked itself in. Old Tom is fine — he's at his sister's house in the next village. The sprite has been baking (badly) all morning, trying to cover its mistake.

scenes.title: The Locked Bakery
scenes.readAloud: You arrive at the bakery. The door is locked — from the OUTSIDE. The chimney is smoking, and the smell of burnt bread fills the street. For just a second, a small face peeks out from a window… then ducks away.
scenes.gmNotes: The sprite watches from inside. If the heroes get in by any route, go to Scene 2.

options.label: Look around
options.outcome: Tiny green footprints lead from the bakery to the woods AND back. One sprite, came in last night.

options.label: Climb to the roof
options.outcome: They can drop down the chimney into the kitchen.

options.label: Force the door
options.outcome: The door breaks open. The mayor mentions they'll have to pay for it later — funny, not punishing.

options.label: Talk through the window
options.outcome: The sprite pretends to be the baker in a high voice: "Yes, I am Tom! Go away!"

scenes.title: The Smoky Kitchen
scenes.readAloud: Inside, smoke fills the kitchen. Five loaves are burning in the oven. On the counter stands a Mischief Sprite, wearing Old Tom's apron and trying very hard to look bigger than it is.
scenes.gmNotes: The bread: if nobody pulls it out within two rounds, the kitchen catches fire — everyone takes 1 damage per round until they leave or put it out. The sprite tries to ESCAPE, not fight: it hides, throws flour to make Speed rolls harder, and aims for a window. If cornered, it cries and confesses.

options.label: Talk it down
options.outcome: The sprite admits it locked itself in and will help if the heroes promise not to tell the mayor. The Healer's Calm spell auto-succeeds here.

scenes.title: Where Is Tom?
scenes.readAloud: With the fire out and the sprite dealt with, you search the shop. On the counter, fallen behind a flour sack, is a note in messy handwriting: "Gone to see my sister Marigold in Riverbend. Back tomorrow. — Tom." The mayor never saw it. When you bring him the truth, he laughs out loud.
scenes.gmNotes: The mayor pays 20 gold and hands over a loaf of (slightly burnt) bread. If the heroes were kind to the sprite, it leaves a tiny silver bell — ringing it summons the sprite once for help.

rewards.label: A loaf of slightly burnt bread (homebrew)
Tiny Silver Bell — only if they were kind to the sprite (homebrew, magic)

adventures.title: The Sheep in the Tree
adventures.hook: A farmer named Beatrice runs up, out of breath. "My sheep — Cloudy — she's STUCK in a tree! And there's something circling. Please, help!"
adventures.secret: A young griffin (more curious than dangerous) picked up the sheep, flew off, and dropped her into a tall oak when she wriggled. The sheep is fine but stuck. The griffin circles, trying to get its prize back. A small group of goblins hides nearby, hoping to grab the sheep for dinner.

scenes.title: The Big Oak Tree
scenes.readAloud: A very confused sheep bleats from a high branch, about thirty feet up. Above the tree, a young griffin circles in slow, curious loops. It hasn't attacked — yet.
scenes.gmNotes: If the heroes ignore the griffin, it gets impatient and dives at one hero on round 3.

options.label: Climb the oak
options.outcome: Climb safely. On a fail: slip and try again — no damage, just funny. Heavy armor gives −1.

options.label: Healer's Animal Friend
options.outcome: Calms either the sheep OR the griffin. The griffin can be talked into helping: "Lower us down? Rrr. Okay."

options.label: Wizard's Light, used cleverly
options.outcome: Can scare the griffin off. Reward clever spell use.

scenes.title: The Goblin Ambush
scenes.readAloud: Just as you start helping the sheep, three goblins burst from the bushes. "GIVE US THE SHEEP! WE NEED DINNER!"
scenes.gmNotes: Standard combat. Goblins are cowardly — when half are down, the rest run.

options.label: Scout spots them in advance
options.outcome: On arrival — sets up a Sneak Attack before the ambush springs.

options.label: Talk instead of fight
options.outcome: Convince the goblins to trade for food instead of stealing. A valid solution with a small reward.

scenes.title: Cloudy Comes Home
scenes.readAloud: Beatrice meets you on the road with a basket of fresh bread and cheese, hugging Cloudy so hard the sheep squeaks.
scenes.gmNotes: If the heroes befriended the griffin, it shows up sometimes to help — once per adventure, it will carry one hero somewhere. Bonus: if they fed the goblins instead of fighting, the goblins won't rob travelers on this road again. Word gets around.

rewards.label: Griffin friendship — once per adventure, it carries one hero (story reward)

adventures.title: The Sleepy Dragon's Hoard
adventures.tone: Dungeon crawl — real adventure, classic loot
adventures.hook: An old map turns up at the village market, showing a cave under Whisper Hill. "Dragon's hoard inside. Dragon sleeps for 100 years. The 100 years end NEXT WEEK." If you hurry, you can grab the treasure before the dragon wakes!
adventures.secret: The map is real. The dragon is real. But the cave is full of OTHER things that moved in over 100 years — a goblin family, cave slimes, and a haunted suit of armor. And the dragon woke up three days early.

scenes.title: The Cave Mouth
scenes.readAloud: A round stone door is set into the hill, circled with glowing runes. Carved above it, a poem: "Three friends share my key: the wind that whistles, the water that runs, the fire that warms. Speak my friends in order, and I will open."
scenes.gmNotes: The answer is WIND, WATER, FIRE. Wizard's Light can count as "fire." Wrong answer: the runes flash and a stone fist gently bonks one hero on the nose — 1 damage, very embarrassing.

options.label: Solve the riddle
options.outcome: They figure out the elements — or a hero just thinks to try speaking them.

scenes.title: The Goblin Kitchen
scenes.readAloud: A wide room with a crackling fire pit. A goblin parent looks up from a cooking pot, startled — and two small goblin kids peek out from behind a barrel. Nobody here looks like they want a fight.
scenes.gmNotes: They're a FAMILY. Combat only if the heroes attack first — the parent is the only fighter; the kids cry. In the kitchen: 5 gold, a sack of dried mushrooms (sells for 3 gold), and an old key labeled "DEEP DOOR."

options.label: Talk — or show any kindness
options.outcome: The parent calms, tells them about the deeper cave, and warns of a haunted suit of armor.

rewards.label: Sack of dried mushrooms — sells for 3 gold (homebrew)

scenes.title: The Slime Tunnel
scenes.readAloud: A narrow passage drips with water. The walls glisten a little too much…
scenes.gmNotes: Two cave slimes cling to the walls and drop on the first hero past. Surprise: Speed 13+ to spot them first; on a fail, the lead hero takes one free hit. Tactics: a slime SPLITS when hit hard (5+ damage) — each half has 3 HP and does d4 (use the improviser: Wimpy, name it "Half-Slime"). On hit, the hero is Stuck until they roll Might 10+ on their turn. The DEEP DOOR key fits the locked door past the slimes.

options.label: Spot the slimes first
options.outcome: The party isn't surprised — no free hit.

options.label: Pick the deep door's lock
options.outcome: Opens without the key. (The key from the goblin kitchen opens it free.)

scenes.title: The Haunted Knight
scenes.readAloud: A tall stone room. On a pedestal stands a dusty suit of armor holding a sword. As you step inside, the helmet slowly turns toward you — and the armor clanks to life.
scenes.gmNotes: It's a ghost — only Mind-based attacks hurt it (Wizard's Zap, Healer spells). Other hits CLANG but do no damage. Hint for the kids: on a missed hit, say "Your sword passes RIGHT THROUGH it." Peaceful end: the ghost was a knight who failed his duty — Healer's Calm plus "Your watch is over, the dragon is awake again" sends him to rest. He drops his sword and bows.

rewards.label: The Haunted Sword — +1 damage, glows blue near ghosts (homebrew, magic)

scenes.title: The Hoard (and the Dragon)
scenes.readAloud: A huge cavern, glittering with GOLD in every direction. And in the middle of it all — a small green dragon, wide awake and very grumpy. "Did you wake me up THREE DAYS EARLY?"
scenes.gmNotes: Fight: tough! Heroes need teamwork — the dragon's first sneeze (on a natural 1) hits everyone in front for d6 fire each. Bargain (the smart one): Mind 13+ or a clever offer — there's so much gold the dragon doesn't mind sharing; each hero takes ONE thing if they leave peacefully and keep the secret. Trick: throw the Healer's Calm on the dragon, then tip-toe out with what they can carry.

options.label: Bargain with the dragon
options.outcome: Or a clever offer. Each hero takes one thing, leaves peacefully, keeps the secret.

options.label: The Calm trick
options.outcome: Healer's Calm on the dragon, then tip-toe out with what they can carry.

rewards.label: Win or bargain: 100 gold each + one magic item per hero
The Calm trick: 50 gold each — and everyone keeps their lives, also a win
